title: Knowledge cloud run writes untenanted wiki rows and retires existing wiki pages
description: MoM 2026-11-11/12: the public wiki index went empty. The cloud knowledge run has no tenant (PAPYRUS_TENANT_ID is not in the task environment), so wiki sync/publish wrote Item and PublishedItem rows with no tenantId/tenantSlug/typeStatus/sectionStatus stamp, which tenant-scoped renders cannot see. Ops stamped 29 Item + 29 PublishedItem rows by hand. Separately the wiki-sync stage passed --retire every day, retiring existing wiki pages of kinds the vocabulary does not declare; crawlers may have indexed them. Fix: a command with no tenant refuses to write into a backend whose Items carry one; wiki sync never retires (flag and code path removed).
